cell_type.evidence: These samples were incubated with Dynabeads® Protein G, washed, and then incubated with protein extracts,derived from proximal or distal sperm cells of WT naïve mice, following the manufacturer’s protocol (Immunoprecipitation Kit – DynabeadsTM Protein G, 10006D, Invitrogen).

material_type.evidence: We characterized the sperm proteins recognized by the antibodies in mouse serum and epididymal fluid after immune tolerance disruption by performing mass spectrometry-based label-free quantitative proteomics.
